foundry_calls.text: Lord Malachar keeps this valley fed through winter. Whatever you think you know, stranger — the town stands by him.
foundry_calls.speaker: Burgomaster Varga

foundry_calls.text: His voice is steady. His hands, folded on the desk, are not.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

llm_calls: [Aria]: I ask the burgomaster straight out: can Lord Malachar be trusted?
